hero.name: Maria Victoria
hero.content: I am a mobile and web developer with 3 years of hands-on experience building cross-platform iOS and Android apps with React Native, Expo and TypeScript, as well as web products with React and Next.js. I manage state with Redux and Context API, integrate RESTful APIs and third-party services such as Mapbox and Expo Notifications, optimise mobile performance and apply mobile security best practices. My full-stack background in Node.js, Python, Docker and cloud infrastructure gives me a clear view of how a mobile product works end to end. I write clean, maintainable and reusable code, take part in code reviews and architectural decisions, and work independently in remote Agile teams.

about.text: Passionate about software engineering and holding a degree in Mathematics from the University of Havana, I am currently pursuing a Technologist Degree in Systems Analysis and Development at UNIASSELVI. I have 3 years of experience building mobile apps with React Native, Expo and TypeScript, alongside the web product in React and Next.js. Earlier in my career I worked on Python microservices (Flask, Django) with Docker on GCP and AWS, managed Linux virtual machines, maintained data gateways from PostgreSQL and MySQL to Power BI, and built web scraping tools with Python and Selenium. My skills include React Native, Expo EAS Build, Redux, React Navigation, Mapbox, push notifications, Kotlin for native Android modules, Node.js, PostgreSQL, GitHub Actions and Docker. I speak Spanish (native), English (advanced) and Portuguese (intermediate), and I focus on quality, maintainability, performance and aligning deliverables with business goals.

experiences.description: I develop and maintain cross-platform mobile apps for iOS and Android with React Native, Expo and TypeScript, alongside the web product in React and Next.js. I manage application state with Redux and Context API, optimise mobile performance (rendering, navigation and load times) and integrate RESTful APIs (Node.js, PostgreSQL) and third-party services such as Mapbox and Expo Notifications for maps, geolocation, real-time features and push notifications. I apply mobile security best practices in authentication, API communication and handling of user data, debug issues across iOS and Android (writing native Android modules in Kotlin where needed), and ship new features from Figma prototypes together with designers and cross-functional teams. I keep quality high with automated tests, code review and CI/CD (GitHub Actions).

Contracted by BTech to provide software and data services to a SaaS client in customer experience (CX), AI and process automation. I developed and containerised Python services (Flask, Django) with Docker in a microservice architecture deployed on GCP and AWS, provisioned and managed Linux virtual machines on Google Cloud, maintained data gateways connecting PostgreSQL and MySQL sources to Power BI while optimising SQL queries, and built web scraping tools with Python and Selenium to automate external data collection.

projects.title: Hirekit
projects.description: I developed with my colleague Ross-cripto a professional optimization platform that allows users to generate CVs tailored to specific job offers, automatically enhance their LinkedIn profiles, and create professional posts based on their skills and experience. The project aims to help candidates stand out in recruitment processes and strengthen their personal brand through automated, AI-powered tools.

projects.title: Recipe App
projects.description: A modern web application for managing recipes, developed with React and TypeScript (Vite). It allows you to create, edit, view and search recipes, manage tags and ingredients, mark favorites and manage user profiles.

projects.title: Text Similarity Finder
projects.description: A project that allows searching for similar text strings within a set of files.

projects.title: Crypto-Backtesting
projects.description: Implements a complete quantitative analysis pipeline for the BTC/USDT pair..

projects.title: Six Degrees of Separation
projects.description: Implementation of a graph search algorithm to find the minimum number of degrees of separation between two actors, using IMDB data to construct the graph.
